summary: Reduces an input CHOP channel to analysis values such as average, maximum, minimum, peaks, or RMS-like summaries. Useful for turning audio or control streams into stable modulation signals.

key_params.name: function
key_params.note: Analysis operation such as average, maximum, minimum, or peak-related modes

key_params.name: scope
key_params.note: Controls whether analysis is per-channel or across channels

key_params.name: timeslice
key_params.note: Use time-sliced behavior for live streams when appropriate

common_gotchas: Analyze CHOP can collapse many samples to one value; use Math CHOP afterward to scale the range for visual controls.
For live audio, confirm the upstream CHOP is cooking and producing nonzero channels before trusting the analysis value.
